input.rationale: Section 12(b) gives only a breach-of-contract indemnity from TrueLink (breach of the Agreement or failure to perform its obligations); there is no indemnity anywhere in the document for third-party intellectual property infringement claims relating to the Interface or Hosting/Support Services, nor for TrueLink's breach of law, data incidents or wilful misconduct. By contrast Client's indemnity in 12(a) is broad (Client Content, Web Site, System Agreement breaches, product liability). Absence of any Vendor IP indemnity fails even the fallback position, so we added the standard supplier indemnity with the usual notice/control/cooperation procedure. We did not narrow Client's 12(a) indemnity in this pass, as it is largely tied to Client Content and Client's own web site.

proposal.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data/security incidents and gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity currently covers only its own breach of this Agreement, so we have no protection if the Interface or Hosting Services draw a third-party IP claim. We have added the standard supplier indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, TrueLink-caused data incidents and wilful misconduct; if preferred, we can accept an IP-only indemnity with the usual modification/combination exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies.

ops.text: c. TrueLink shall further defend, indemnify and hold Client and its affiliates harmless from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Interface, the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable provided by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of any applicable law, rule or regulation; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content or other Client data caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. The indemnified party shall give prompt notice of the claim, the indemnifying party shall control the defense and settlement (provided no settlement imposing liability on the indemnified party shall be made without its consent), and the indemnified party shall provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.
